_note: Proposed subsections of TestRail section 136701 "Internal Work order (11/12/2026)" (suite 1, Founder Mode), one per story with plain names. Ids are null: no TestRail write by the case worker; the coordinator creates them with the QA lead's go-ahead. Story 11 (Open API and webhooks) lives in "API" (Rule 4: every case with API requests, responses or status codes). DATA holds the cross-surface number parity cases (Rule 116); INV the invariant set (Rule 96, skill 17: billable work orders and everything the PRD says is unchanged); S13 the starting categories a tester can see on a new organization; REL the release-day checks of existing organizations. "Design — how it looks" is filled by the design round (Rule 126). WAIT-PO, BLK and PROD are the standing folders (cases waiting on the PO, blocked on another release, run on production after the release); build.py assigns them. Cases a tester cannot set up are kept in the library only (NO-MANUAL-PROPOSAL.md) and are not written to TestRail.
